Added labeled parasite dosing and a suitability table separating contraindications from precautions. Made mechanism explanations visible and retained the retracted-report exclusion. Outcome grades and independent-trial records are unchanged.

entries.title: Evidence interpretation expanded
entries.summary: Clarified the higher-dose acute-COVID recovery result, secondary outcomes and limits of mechanism and Long COVID inference.

entries.title: Evidence interpretation expanded

entries.title: Evidence interpretation expanded

entries.title: Multiple myeloma evidence expanded
entries.summary: Expanded metformin, itraconazole-combination and simvastatin experimental findings. Distinguished these anticancer hypotheses from aspirin clot-prevention research and established myeloma-treatment context.

entries.title: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome evidence expanded
entries.summary: Added three uncontrolled naltrexone case reports, distinguished symptom histories from patient-derived immune-cell measurements, and added the cited naltrexone opioid-related label safety context.

entries.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis evidence expanded
entries.summary: Clarified the harmful primary functional result, its scoped Moderate confidence, and the separate uncertainty around mortality, adverse events and the proposed laboratory rationale.

entries.title: Basal-cell carcinoma evidence expanded
entries.summary: Clarified the exploratory tumor-area result, primary pathway/proliferation biomarkers, limited duration and reported heart-failure safety signal.

entries.title: Rituximab label context expanded
entries.summary: Expanded the cited product label's mechanism, safety and dosing context and distinguished it from the selected repurposing evidence. Added scoped Low clinical-confidence explanations; existing outcome assessments and source reviews retain their prior state.

entries.title: Maraviroc human-evidence coverage clarified
entries.summary: Clarified whether the cited primary papers describe human treatment or laboratory work, with a scoped Low clinical-confidence explanation. Existing outcome and source-review states are unchanged.

entries.title: Fluconazole human-evidence coverage clarified

entries.title: Fenbendazole evidence and status corrected
entries.summary: Expanded mixed cancer-model findings, model-only mechanism explanations and human liver-injury reports. Added scoped clinical-translation confidence and explicit human dosing gaps. Corrected the FDA veterinary approval citation and clarified that fenbendazole is not approved for human use.

entries.title: Multiple myeloma sources added
entries.summary: Added existing laboratory reports on metformin, itraconazole with arsenic trioxide, and simvastatin, plus an aspirin thromboprophylaxis report and secondary context. The clot-prevention endpoint remains separate from cancer control; laboratory results remain separate from patient outcomes. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Vitiligo source coverage expanded
entries.summary: Added existing rituximab, minocycline and simvastatin reports and textbook context. The uncontrolled pilot, active-comparator study and placebo-controlled study remain distinct; the chapter is background rather than another primary trial. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Healthspan and mouse lifespan sources added
entries.summary: Added the existing PEARL healthspan report, mouse lifespan experiment and a separate sirolimus product label. Human healthspan measures, mouse survival and product-label information remain distinct; no human lifespan finding or formulation equivalence is added. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Aging-mouse oral-health report added
entries.summary: Added an existing report of periodontal inflammation and bone loss in aged mice. This adds a specific animal health outcome rather than evidence of human lifespan extension. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Acute COVID-19 report added
entries.summary: Added the existing COVID-OUT acute-infection report to the source list. This does not add a metformin outcome to ivermectin or a finding about treating established Long COVID. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Acute COVID-19 report added
entries.summary: Added the existing COVID-OUT acute-infection report to the source list. This does not add a metformin outcome to fluvoxamine or clear the separate REVIVE source-integrity limitation. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: PAX-D protocol reference added
entries.summary: Added the existing PAX-D protocol as background alongside the outcome report. The protocol does not add observed efficacy results or another independent trial. Existing outcome assessments and review status are unchanged.

entries.title: Evidence grouped by condition and outcome
entries.summary: Reorganized drug and condition tables into shared outcome summaries with a separate A–F benefit assessment, quantitative effect and deduplicated randomized-trial and participant counts. Combined duplicate reports of compatible outcomes. Added source-linked mechanisms, study details and assessment limits to the right research sidebar. These selected-source editorial assessments do not add newly acquired studies or independent clinical review.

entries.title: Metformin trial findings added to the evidence table
entries.summary: Added separately scoped findings for prostate-cancer survival, lung-cancer progression and survival, colorectal adenoma recurrence, the acute COVID-19 composite endpoint, and lean body mass during resistance training. Each result has its own source-linked assessment and limitations; companion reports are not counted as independent trials.

entries.title: Expanded metformin overview and mechanisms
entries.summary: Expanded the introduction to cover the approved diabetes indication and the range of repurposing investigations. Replaced mechanism accordions with visible explanations of insulin signaling, AMPK/mTOR and autophagy, plus a condition-by-condition table distinguishing proposed actions, measurements and translation limits. Existing mechanism links and citations are preserved.

entries.title: Treatment suitability tables added
entries.summary: Added selected U.S. label restrictions for metformin tablets and itraconazole capsules, separating contraindications, indication-specific restrictions, precautions and medication review. Each table links to its supporting label.

entries.title: Contraindications easier to identify
entries.summary: Added an explicit “Who should not be considered?” heading and clarified the distinction between contraindications, precautions and trial applicability. Existing cited restrictions are retained.
